# Deming Children's Dentistry and Orthodontics

> Comprehensive pediatric dental and orthodontic care for children ages 1-21 in Deming, New Mexico, with specialized services for special needs patients and Medicaid coverage.

Deming Children's Dentistry and Orthodontics is a full-service pediatric dental practice offering preventative care, orthodontics (braces and Invisalign), special needs dentistry with sedation options, and accepts Medicaid. The practice serves the Deming, New Mexico community with modern technology including digital x-rays and online appointment scheduling through NexHealth.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Special Needs Dentistry
- Sedation Dentistry
- Medicaid Coverage
- Preventative Care

- Braces

- Appointment Scheduling
- Deming, New Mexico
- Restorative Procedures

## Core Services

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://www.demingchildrensdentistry.com/kid-dentistry): Pediatric dentistry services for children ages 1-21.
- [Orthodontics](https://www.demingchildrensdentistry.com/orthodontics): Orthodontic services including braces and Invisalign aligners.
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://www.demingchildrensdentistry.com/special-needs-dentistry): Specialized dental care for children with developmental disabilities.
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://www.demingchildrensdentistry.com/special-needs-dentistry/sedation-dentistry): Sedation dentistry and conscious sedation options for dental anxiety.
